title: A variable-variable read with a resolved name consumes the incoming constructor argument

ground_truth.statement: A variable-variable read with a resolved name consumes the incoming constructor argument. Changing that argument changes the public result.

allowed.reason: Psalm cannot resolve the variable-variable assignment precisely. This precision warning is independent of whether the constructor parameter is consumed, which the runtime demonstrates. https://psalm.dev/docs/running_psalm/issues/MixedAssignment/

notes: Clean-room semantic contract derived from the catalog lead, not a copy of its test harness. Changing the constructor argument changes the public result. Independent review corrected the initial FP label for Psalm's MixedAssignment at line 8: the diagnostic reports a dynamic-assignment precision limitation, not an unused constructor parameter. It remains visible as an acknowledged diagnostic at that exact file and line. All three tools satisfy the parameter-consumption criterion. Runtime controls pass.
